content.answer: Fix rule: when updating a Feishu Bitable single-select/multi-select field, merge options by stable id — for every option name that already exists, pass the original option object through unchanged so it keeps its old id; only genuinely new names get fresh ids, allocated starting at max(existing id)+1 — and never rebuild the option list from names alone, because that forces the API to issue brand-new ids and silently clears the option reference in every existing data row.
content.reuse_advice: For any id-referenced catalog update (Bitable select options, dropdowns, tags, statuses, or similar): 1) Read the current catalog first; 2) Match incoming items to existing ones by stable id (or by name only to find the match, then pass the original id-bearing object through); 3) Preserve existing ids for anything unchanged or renamed; 4) Assign new ids only to genuinely new items, continuing the sequence from max(existing id)+1; 5) Treat 'replace the whole list with new objects' as a destructive operation — APIs that accept a full list will re-key references and silently orphan every existing row that pointed at the old ids.
